name: proj-gantt-chart
description: Builds and maintains a Gantt chart for a project, with a schedule table and a Mermaid Gantt chart, baseline versus current dates, rolling-wave detail for the next period, and change notes. Use for "run proj-gantt-chart", "gantt chart", "make a project timeline", "update the project schedule", "baseline versus actual dates", "our Gantt is out of date", "project schedule template", part of the AI for Project Management Pack by 90n.
